name: Dr. Jitesh Kumar
bio: Dr. Jitesh Kumar is a practicing medical professional and founder of Atlas Mentor. He has counseled over 2,500+ Indian medical aspirants and specializes in NMC 2021 gazette compliance, university accreditations, and transparent overseas admissions.

name: Ananya Sharma
role: Head of International Student Affairs & Admissions
bio: Ananya Sharma manages university partnerships and embassy visa processing across Russia, Georgia, Uzbekistan, and Kazakhstan. She brings 8+ years of expertise in international student support.

name: Dr. Rajesh Patel
bio: Dr. Rajesh Patel graduated from Tashkent Medical Academy and cleared FMGE on his first attempt. He mentors foreign medical graduates through licensure exam preparation and clinical internship pathways in India.
